meta.title: Admin — outegro
meta.description: Operator console of the outegro.dev platform.

done.restored: Account restored. The user can sign in again.

done.playerShown: Player shown on the leaderboard again.

replay.start: Before the first shot · {total} moves in total

states.forbiddenBody: Your role does not include this. Ask an owner if you need it.
states.notFoundBody: We could not find {what}. It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.
states.sessionBody: Sign in again to continue where you left off.

states.forbiddenPageTitle: This section is not part of your role

noAccess.title: No access to the console
noAccess.body: You are signed in as {email}, but this account has no admin role.
noAccess.hint: An owner can grant a role in Users → Roles. Until then there is nothing here for you.

monitoring.forbiddenBody: You are signed in as {email}, but your roles do not open monitoring. Ask an owner if you need it.
monitoring.unavailableBody: The console could not reach Identity to confirm your session, so monitoring stays closed for now. Nothing is lost: try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address is wrong or the page has moved.

signIn.title: Run the platform
signIn.lead: Users, access, payments, notifications and the game in one place. Every change carries a reason and lands in the audit log.
signIn.cardTitle: Sign in with your outegro account
signIn.pointRoles: Only operators with an admin role get in; each section follows your permissions.
signIn.pointAudit: Actions ask for a reason and are recorded in the audit log.
signIn.pointIdle: You are signed out after 30 minutes without activity.
signIn.idle: You were signed out after 30 minutes without activity.

errors.state_mismatch: The sign-in link expired or was opened in another tab. Start again.
errors.missing_code: Sign-in was cancelled. Start again when you are ready.
errors.invalid_grant: The sign-in could not be completed. Start again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a minute.

issueKind.renewal_after_revoke: Charged after a revoke: refund it

users.title: Users
users.lead: Find an account by email or ID, see why it has (or lacks) access, and fix it with a recorded reason.
users.noMatchBody: Search looks for part of an email address. Paste a user ID to open the card directly.
users.emptyBody: Accounts appear here after their first sign-in.
users.maskedNote: Emails are masked for your role.

actions.revokeSessionsStays: The account stays active: the user can sign in again.
actions.audited: Recorded in the audit log with your reason.
actions.restoreDescription: {name} will be able to sign in again.
actions.restoreEffect: Sign-in works again across outegro.dev apps.
actions.restoreSessions: Sessions ended by the suspension do not come back.
actions.suspendDescription: {name} loses access until an operator restores the account.
actions.suspendEffect: Sign-in is blocked in every outegro.dev app.
actions.suspendSessions: {count, plural, =0 {There are no active sessions.} one {# active session ends immediately.} other {# active sessions end immediately.}}
actions.suspendSubscriptions: Subscriptions keep running: cancel them separately in Payments if needed.

profile.title: Profile
profile.maskedNote: The email is masked for your role (needs users.read.sensitive).

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.note: Sessions on id.outegro.dev and in every app signed in through it.
sessions.body: {count, plural, one {One session is active. End it if the account may be compromised.} other {# sessions are active. End them all if the account may be compromised.}}
sessions.none: No active sessions. The user is signed out everywhere.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.note: Passkeys on id.outegro.dev. Remove one only when the user lost the device: it will no longer sign in.
passkeys.emptyBody: The user signs in with an email code or Google.
passkeys.revokeDescription: {name} will no longer be able to sign in with it.
passkeys.revokeEffect: The passkey is deleted at once. Open sessions stay; for a lost device, end them too.
passkeys.revokeNotice: The user gets an email and an inbox message: the time only, not your reason.
passkeys.revokeLastMethod: The last way to sign in cannot be removed: with an unverified email and no other passkey or Google, the server refuses.

roles.title: Admin roles
roles.note: Roles open the console. Paid access never does.
roles.grantDescription: {name} gets the role's permissions in the console.
roles.grantEffect: The permissions work on the user's next console request.
roles.grantFresh: Services re-check permissions on every admin command.
roles.audited: Recorded in the audit log with your reason.
roles.roleHint: See what each role allows in the list below.
roles.expiresHint: The role ends at the end of this day (UTC). Leave empty to keep it.
roles.revokeEffect: The permissions stop working immediately: admin commands re-check them.
roles.revokeOwner: The last active owner cannot be removed.
roles.referenceNote: Roles are fixed sets of permissions; highlighted ones are active for this user.

access.title: Product access
access.note: What the user can use right now, as Identity sees it (projected from Payments).
access.emptyBody: The user has not bought anything and has no manual grants.
access.ledgerNote: The source of truth, including ended grants.
access.giveDescription: A manual grant for {name}, owned by Payments.
access.giveEffect: The feature opens within seconds in every app.
access.giveSource: It is marked as manual, separate from purchases.
access.untilHint: Ends at the end of this day (UTC). Leave empty for no end date.
access.audited: Recorded in the audit log with your reason.
access.revokeEffect: Access from this grant ends now.
access.revokeRenewal: Renewal at Lava is cancelled too, so the buyer is not charged again.
access.revokeOthers: Other grants of the same feature (a purchase, a subscription) stay.

notifications.title: Recipient
notifications.noRecipientBody: Notifications learns about an account from Identity events; it appears shortly after sign-up.

battleship.title: Battleship player
battleship.noPlayerBody: A player profile is created on the first visit to the game.

education.noReaderBody: Progress appears once the user opens a book at edu.outegro.dev; Education grants show here too.
education.noBooks: Has not opened a book yet
education.grantsNote: As Education sees them (from Payments). Give or revoke them in Product access.

activity.emptyBy: This user has not taken admin actions.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: Email and Telegram deliveries, templates and channel switches. Paused channels keep their messages waiting.

overview.title: Delivery health
overview.byStateNote: Select a number to open those deliveries.
overview.noDeliveries: No deliveries in the last 24 hours.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.lead: Filters stay in the address, so a filtered list can be shared.
deliveries.noMatchBody: Loosen a filter or reset them all.
deliveries.emptyBody: Messages appear here once services start sending them.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.retryNote: Only failed or unknown deliveries can be retried.
delivery.retryBody: The delivery goes back to the queue with a fresh retry schedule.
delivery.retryUnknownBody: The provider did not confirm this message. It may already have arrived, so a retry can deliver it twice.
delivery.retryEffect: The message is sent again on the same channel.
delivery.retrySchedule: Attempts start from zero with the usual back-off.
delivery.retryUnknownRisk: The previous attempt may have succeeded: the recipient could get it twice.
delivery.confirmUnknown: I understand the recipient may receive this message twice.
delivery.audited: Recorded in the audit log with your reason.
delivery.notRetryablePrivate: Sign-in codes are never re-sent from the console; the user requests a new one.
delivery.notRetryableExpired: The message expired: it is no longer worth sending.
delivery.notRetryableState: Deliveries in the “{state}” state are not retried.
delivery.intentNote: What the producing service asked for. Codes and secrets are redacted.

templates.title: Templates
templates.lead: Rendered with sample data, never real user data.
templates.subject: Subject

channels.title: Channels
channels.neverChanged: Never changed: both channels run by default.
channels.pauseDescription: Messages on this channel wait instead of being sent.
channels.pauseEffect: New and pending deliveries wait; nothing is dropped.
channels.pauseTtl: A message that waits past its time to live expires unsent.
channels.resumeDescription: Waiting messages go out right away.
channels.resumeEffect: Deliveries on this channel start again within seconds.
channels.audited: Recorded in the audit log with your reason.
channels.needsFlags: Pausing and resuming need the services.flags permission.
channels.botNotConfigured: No bot token is configured, so Telegram delivery and linking are off.
channels.botUnreachable: Telegram could not be reached just now; the status below may be outdated.
channels.webhookMismatch: The webhook registered at Telegram differs from the expected address.
channels.testNote: Sent only to your own address or linked chat.
channels.testNoPermission: Sending a test needs the notifications.retry permission.

audit.title: Notifications audit
audit.lead: Retries and channel changes made by operators.
audit.emptyBody: Retries and channel changes will appear here.

payments.lead: Orders, subscriptions and Lava events, revenue per currency and manual grants. Money is shown exactly, from minor units.

overview.currencyNote: Each currency is counted on its own; amounts are never converted or added up.

issues.title: Reconciliation
issues.lead: Discrepancies between Lava and our records. Resolve them at the source, never by editing a status.

refunds.title: Refunds and chargebacks
refunds.lead: A refund is applied only through a verified link to its payment, never by a similar email.
refunds.emptyBody: Refunds and chargebacks from Lava appear here.
refunds.matchTitle: Link this refund to its payment?
refunds.matchDescription: Only after checking the evidence: amount, date and the provider's reference.
refunds.matchEffect: The refund is applied to that payment; access follows its rules.
refunds.matchEvidence: Never link by a similar email alone.
refunds.paymentIdHint: The uuid of the payment in Payments (see the order's payments).
refunds.audited: Recorded in the audit log with your reason.

battleship.title: Battleship
battleship.lead: Live matches, players and moderation. Fleets are visible only here: players never see each other's ships.

matches.title: Matches
matches.lead: Live and finished matches with both fleets and every shot.

match.title: Match
match.abortDescription: {a} vs {b} ends now, without a winner.
match.abortEffect: Both players see the match end with no result.
match.abortPlayers: Players can start a new match right away.
match.audited: Recorded in the moderation log with your reason.
match.boardsNote: Step through the match; each board shows the shots it received.

players.title: Players
players.lead: Search by nickname or paste a user ID.
players.emptyBody: Players appear after their first visit to the game.

player.title: Player
player.resetDescription: “{nickname}” is replaced with a neutral generated name.
player.resetEffect: The player gets a generated nickname and can pick a new one.
player.resetLive: Open game sessions see the new name at once.
player.hideEffect: The player keeps playing; only the public ranking hides them.
player.showEffect: The player appears in the ranking again.
player.audited: Recorded in the moderation log with your reason.

audit.lead: Aborted matches, reset nicknames and leaderboard changes.
audit.emptyBody: Actions taken on matches and players appear here.

education.title: Education
education.lead: Interactive textbooks at edu.outegro.dev: which books are out, who may read them and how far readers get.

assist.title: AI assistant
assist.note: Answers for signed-in readers in open chapters, over the last 7 days.
assist.onHint: Readers see it in open chapters.
assist.pausedHint: Paused for readers until 00:00 UTC: the spending cap is reached. Cached answers are still served.
assist.offHint: Hidden from readers: no model key, safe mode, or switched off in the settings.
assist.perReader: {count, plural, one {# request per reader} other {# requests per reader}}
assist.globalUsed: {used} of {limit, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} today
assist.globalResets: All readers together. Resets at 00:00 UTC.
assist.noGlobalLimitHint: Only each reader's daily limit applies.
assist.counts: Cached answers (the same section and style again) skip the model: no tokens, and nothing taken from the reader's daily limit or the spending cap. Failed: ended without a full answer, after an error or because the reader stopped it.

books.title: Books
books.lead: Every imported book: its status, who may read it and how many do.
books.emptyBody: Books appear after Education imports its content.

book.publishDescription: “{title}” appears in the library at edu.outegro.dev.
book.publishEffect: Readers can find it and open its chapters right away.
book.publishRule: Who reads past the free chapters follows its rule: {rule}.
book.draftTitle: Move this book back to draft?

book.draftEffect: Readers can no longer open it, even with a grant.

book.archiveEffect: Readers can no longer open it; it stays here with its numbers.
book.keepsProgress: Reading progress and grants are kept; publishing again restores access.
book.audited: Recorded in the Education audit with your reason.
book.accessEffect: The new rule applies to the next chapter a reader opens.
book.accessReaders: Readers whose grant the new rule no longer lists keep only the free chapters.
book.accessGrants: Grants are not touched: give or revoke them in Payments.

modeHints.free: Every chapter opens to anyone, even without signing in.
modeHints.signed_in: Every chapter opens to any signed-in reader; nothing to buy.
modeHints.grant: A Payments grant opens the book; the first chapters can stay free.

book.featuresHint: The library is every book (edu:library); this book alone is edu:book.{slug}.
book.previewHint: {count, plural, one {Signed-in readers read them without a grant; at most # chapter.} other {Signed-in readers read them without a grant; at most # chapters.}}

rule.signedInDetail: Every signed-in reader reads every chapter; nothing to buy.

readers.lead: Progress per reader and book, most recently active first. Paste a user ID to see one reader.
readers.emptyBody: Nobody here with these filters; readers appear after they open a book.
